title: Who's who in the photo
goal: Describe and identify people with -(y)An participles, and follow a description of a wedding photo.

intro.text: Point people out by what they're doing and how they look: *Annemin yanında oturan yaşlı adam dedem* (The old man sitting next to my mother is my grandfather). Add a few words for hair and height: *sarışın*, *esmer*, *kıvırcık*, *uzun boylu*.

exercises.title: Düğün fotoğrafı
exercises.passage:
Bu fotoğraf ablamın düğününden. Ortada beyaz gelinlik giyen kadın ablam Zeynep, yanında duran uzun boylu adam da eşi Murat. Zeynep'in solunda duran gözlüklü, kıvırcık saçlı kadın annem. Annemin yanında oturan yaşlı adam dedem; o gün çok mutluydu ve bütün gece dans etti.

Arkada duran esmer genç Murat'ın kardeşi Emre. Emre'nin yanında gülen sarışın kız kim? Ben de bilmiyorum. Düğüne gelenlerin çoğunu tanımıyordum.
exercises.translation: This photo is from my older sister's wedding. The woman in the middle wearing a white wedding dress is my sister Zeynep, and the tall man standing next to her is her husband, Murat. The curly-haired woman with glasses standing on Zeynep's left is my mother. The old man sitting next to my mother is my grandfather; he was very happy that day and danced all night. The dark-haired young man standing at the back is Murat's brother Emre. Who's the blond girl laughing next to Emre? I don't know either. I didn't know most of the people who came to the wedding.

questions.q: Who is the tall man standing next to Zeynep?
questions.explain: *Yanında duran uzun boylu adam da eşi Murat*: the clause, the adjective, then the noun.

questions.q: Who is the curly-haired woman with glasses?
What does the narrator know about the blond girl?
options: Nothing: she doesn't know who she is

questions.q: What does *Düğüne gelenlerin çoğunu tanımıyordum* tell you?
options: She didn't know most of the guests
Most of the guests didn't come
She didn't go to the wedding
questions.explain: *Gelenlerin çoğu*: **most of those who came**, a headless participle with the genitive.

exercises.prompt: Who is the blond girl standing next to Emre?
accept: Emre'nin yanında duran sarışın kız kim?

reject.answer: Emre'nin yanında sarışın duran kız kim?
reject.why: The participle clause comes first, then the adjective: *yanında duran sarışın kız*.

exercises.text: Arkada dur___ esmer genç Murat'ın kardeş___.
exercises.en: The dark-haired young man standing at the back is Murat's brother.

reject.why: Harmony: *dur-* has u, a back vowel, so *-an*.
Before a noun, use the participle: *arkada duran genç*.

exercises.explain: *Duran* describes *genç*; *Murat'ın kardeşi* is the genitive and possessive of [A1 unit 10](gp-genitive-possessive).

exercises.tr: Annemin yanında oturan yaşlı adam dedem.
exercises.en: The old man sitting next to my mother is my grandfather.

exercises.question: Which is **a tall man reading a newspaper**?
options: gazete okuyan uzun boylu bir adam
bir gazete okuyan uzun boylu adam
uzun boylu bir adam gazete okuyan

why.1: Here *bir* goes with *gazete*: **the tall man reading a newspaper**. For **a** man, put *bir* just before *adam*.
why.2: The participle clause goes before the noun, not after it.

exercises.explain: Clause, adjective, *bir*, noun: *gazete okuyan uzun boylu bir adam*.

exercises.text: I did not know most of the people who came to the wedding.
accept: I did not know most of the guests.
The woman with curly hair and glasses is my mother.
The woman with curly hair and glasses is my [mom|mum].
The curly-haired woman with glasses is my [mother|mom|mum].

exercises.prompt: I do not know the people sitting at the back.

reject.why: They are the object of *tanımak*, and definite: *oturanları*.

exercises.question: A mother has lost her child at the market. Where is the child?

context.en: What does the child look like?

context.tr: Beş yaşında, sarışın bir kız. Kırmızı bir ceket giyiyor ve elinde mavi bir balon var.
context.en: A blond girl, five years old. She's wearing a red jacket and holding a blue balloon.
The girl eating an ice cream over there?
Yes, that's her! Thank you so much.

options: Over there, eating an ice cream
exercises.explain: *Şurada dondurma yiyen kız*: *ye-* + `-(y)An` gives *yiyen*, **the girl eating an ice cream**.
*ye-* becomes *yi-* before the buffer y, as in *yiyor*: *yi-y-en*.

exercises.prompt: Everyone who came to the wedding was very happy.
